spans.s:
panasa, m. breadfruit-tree;
 n. its fruit.
pānasa, a. made from the bread-fruit.
pan-āya, Ā. show to be admirable.
pāntha, m. wayfarer, traveller: -tva, n. 🞄life of a wayfarer.

pan-na, pp. √ pad: -gá, m. (low-going), 🞄(ī, f.) snake;
 snake-demon: -maya, a. (ī) 🞄consisting of snakes, -rāja, m. king of the 🞄snake-demons, -indra, m. id., -īśvara, m. id..
pāṃsú, m. particle of dust, grain of 🞄sand: gnly. pl. dust, sand.
